name: GhostLink
description: Headless styled anchor with external and disabled contracts. useGhostLink owns behavior; GhostLink is the thin host. Themed visual props live on @ghostvue/themes.

props.name: external
props.description: Shows the external icon for same-tab outbound links.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Visible link text. Provide aria-label or aria-labelledby when the slot is empty.

slots.name: externalIndicator
slots.description: Decorative external icon inside data-part=external-icon. Hidden from assistive technology.

exposed.name: blur
exposed.description: Removes focus from the host when mounted.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The navigable host element after mount, or `null` before mount.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Moves focus to the host when mounted and not disabled.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Navigation is unavailable; href is removed on native anchors.

keyboard.Tab: Moves focus to enabled links in document order.
keyboard.Enter: Activates the native link when focused.
